! Game text
| [Grabber] Deploy on table. Once per game, {{Errata hl|1=may stack one Interrupt just played here.}} To play any new Interrupt of same name, player must first stack it here. May place this Effect in Lost Pile (place all cards here in owners’ Used Pile) to {{Errata hl|1=retrieve one Rebel starship into hand.}} (Immune to Alter.) || [Grabber] Deploy on table. Once per game, {{Errata hl|1=if opponent just played an Interrupt, may stack it here.}} To play any new Interrupt of same name, players must first stack it here. May place this Effect in Lost Pile (place cards here in owners’ Used Pile) to {{Errata hl|1=retrieve a starship.}} (Immune to Alter.)
